scenes.title: A delivery question, on two screens
scenes.text: Welcome to FarmTact. On the left is the desktop workspace; on the right, the same journey on mobile. We are using an isolated synthetic farm. Start with the short introduction: inspect a delivery question, compare plans, review changes, and report what happened.

scenes.title: Calculate real planting alternatives
scenes.text: Choose Compare planting plans. The local numerical engine now checks crop timing and resource constraints against the recorded demand. This is a real calculation in the app. When it finishes, the alternatives appear with their own coverage, expiry, and contribution margin, ready for comparison.

scenes.title: Compare the tradeoffs
scenes.text: We inspect Balanced, then Resilient, and return to Balanced. Watch the selected candidate and the projected measures change together. Feasible means the model's constraints hold; it does not promise that every order is filled. Read the shortfall alongside the margin before making a choice.
